entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I bought this VeloBand sensor and it's a complete piece of junk. It's not working and I want my money back.
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing an issue with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault?

A technical fault? It's defective! The thing is completely broken. It won't sync with my app, the readings are garbage... it's just dead. I'm not going to be your beta tester. I want a refund, and I want it now. Don't waste my time.
I completely understand your frustration, and I apologize for the trouble this has caused. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your order number or the email address you used to purchase?
It's under john.doe@email.com. Look, I'm not interested in troubleshooting. Just process the return. If you can't do that, get me your manager. I'll be posting reviews about this everywhere.
I understand, sir. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order here, delivered on January 1st. That's no problem at all. I just need to quickly verify our return policy.
Alright, I've checked our system. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, as long as the item is in its original condition.
10 days? Okay, good. So we're done here? Are you sending the label or what?

Yes, absolutely. Since you received it just 16 days ago, you are unfortunately outside that 10-day window. I have gone ahead and approved your return for a full refund. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email right now.
Okay, fine. That's what I wanted in the first place. I see the email just came through. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the defective item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
